Term of the week · 2026-W40

Frankenstack

A marketing or advertising technology stack assembled from many separately bought tools that were bolted together over time and do not work as one system.

On 8 September 2026, MMA's Decoding AI for Marketing podcast asked whether AI can fix advertising's Frankenstack. Guest Mike Lane, CEO of Fluency, argued that stitching new AI tools onto fragmented platforms can create one instead.
